// diagnostic

E1313

`` `{arg}` doesn't implement `{Trait}` `` — a trait-bounded variadic call-site argument fails one of the bound trait(s) (D-ANY-JAI1).

What

`` `{arg}` doesn't implement `{Trait}` `` — a trait-bounded variadic call-site argument fails one of the bound trait(s) (D-ANY-JAI1).

Why

`{param}: ...{Trait}` (or `...[A, B]`) checks every argument against the bound trait(s) — that's how a function like this accepts a mix of types safely, with each argument monomorphized to its own concrete type (zero boxing).

Fix

Implement `{Trait}` for the argument's type, or drop the value from this call.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1313: tests/ui/variadic_trait_bound_unmet.stderr.

Error [E1313]: `fn(Int) =[]=> Int` doesn't implement `Renderable`
  --> tests/ui/variadic_trait_bound_unmet.jet:9:16
    |
  9 |     log_all(1, double)
    |                ^^^^^^
 Why: `parts: ...Renderable` checks every argument against `Renderable` — that's how `log_all` accepts a mix of types safely
 Fix: implement `Renderable` for `fn(Int) =[]=> Int`'s type, or drop the value from this call
